title: Move rigid broad phase onto the shared BVH
requires: A physical supported GPU, shared Slang build toolchain and public-API test harness
scope: Replace rigid all-pairs world-bound scanning with shared tick-snapshot candidates while retaining cached mesh-local collision geometry. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Remove count-squared candidate flag work from the new profile; demonstrate sparse/dense scaling and bounded candidate storage.
Match independent collision-candidate oracles for fast motion, rotating thin shapes, margins, disabled constrained pairs and generation changes.
Reuse the one tick index throughout bounded contact/joint solves; no second build/refit after an iteration.
Retain narrow-phase correctness/lifetime tests and record dispatch/candidate/byte budgets at unchanged body/mesh counts.
